starter-stock-reactive-code-parent.scope: The stock retest activated 941, paid 7 IS per second and handled external damage and healing once each. A health change after toggle-off produced no callback, and the off response started the 15 s own reuse.

starter-stock-reactive-code-damage-pulse.head: e6e15cf54ce690f3523d423bf1881c96ab6756a8
starter-stock-reactive-code-damage-pulse.scope: Stock PR545 retest recorded two 50-damage, zero-resisted hits on QAEnemy at PacketLog 2485 and 2810. Its HP updates show 1500→1450→1400. The nearby friendly received no hit or HP update during this stage. Wider radius and non-neutral scaling were outside this run.

starter-stock-code-conversion-parent.head: e6e15cf54ce690f3523d423bf1881c96ab6756a8
starter-stock-code-conversion-parent.scope: The stock retest paid 6 IS per second. One external health change healed CSR 350→410 and QAFriend 250→310 without recursively firing 943. After toggle-off the next health change produced no heal. PacketLog 2024 shows the 15 s own reuse.

starter-stock-trojan-horse-pulse.head: e6e15cf54ce690f3523d423bf1881c96ab6756a8
starter-stock-trojan-horse-pulse.scope: The first stock Trojan Horse pulse debited only the surviving hostile 500→480 and separately debited CSR 550→530 at PacketLog 3494–3499. The friendly received neither debit nor hit. The 15 s own reuse began at activation, before the pulse.
